text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is T.M.! In the lead is T.M.—!
In the lead is T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki is my grand stage!
The victor is none other than T.M. Opera O!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho, I hear the rustling of fresh verdure! It is as if all of life has sprouted just to sing my praises!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, today's MVT!
Who is the Most Valuable T.M. Opera O!?
choice_data_list: It's you, T M Opera O!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, it is I!
Now this is a performance truly worthy of the leading star!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Most is me! The Variable is also me!
Opera O is me! In other words, ME!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hey, everybody! It's meeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't really understand what they were saying, but the sheer scale of their joy came through loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...That's unfortunate, Ayabe-san.
However, you have nothing to regret.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because you were there
that our early spring performance, 'Ah, Beautiful Satsuki Sho',
was such a massive hit.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: My rhythm was just... thrown off...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hoh, and your condition... is?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because you were there, my pace was thrown off.
Though getting dragged along was due to my own weakness...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Still... without you...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hate me, go ahead and hate me!
It's only natural for rivals to despise the leading star!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Still, Ayabe-san...
Was your lack of sharpness really my fault?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If hating me improves your running,
I don't mind in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What do you even understand about me...?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely, everything!
You're an Umamusume, and you wanted to win the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And the reason I couldn't focus today
lies within myself."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Face the agony of creation.
Just as I always face the mirror.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us depart, my Trainer!
Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overjoyed by the victory, T.M. Opera O
laughed triumphantly all the way back.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What's with... that person...?
Could they have... seen through me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"That can't be.
And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Facing... myself...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, tonight is a victory party!
Dance, everybody, dance!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, Opera O-san...! Um...
I'm not very good at dancing, though~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I've tired myself out from dancing a bit.
Well then, Trainer, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Onto the twilight balcony.
The classic stage for romance, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was taken out to the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've grasped one star,
let us decide on our next goal.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now that I have been crowned with the Satsuki,
where is the new theater upon which I shall dance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The answer is—obvious.
Once you claim the first crown, your only goal is the second.
choice_data_list: To Tokyo Racecourse, for the Japanese Derby

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, as expected. Very well.
The supreme race shining brilliantly in the Classic sky.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san will likely... no, definitely enter the race and add brilliance to it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Look up at the night sky... Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That star—is the star of the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The North Star shone overhead.
However... T.M. Opera O
arbitrarily renamed it."
